steps.en: A decision work item is routed to the officer's dashboard
steps.id: Work item untuk keputusan di-route ke dashboard officer
steps.why_en: No dashboard or work item receiver exists; allocation is hard-coded to self.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada dashboard atau penerima work item; alokasi di-hardcode ke diri sendiri.

steps.en: Officer opens the routed work item to view the notice
steps.id: Officer membuka work item untuk melihat notice
steps.why_en: Notice lists can be opened, but not from a dashboard work item.
steps.why_id: Daftar notice bisa dibuka, tetapi bukan dari work item di dashboard.

steps.en: Officer records a decision on the notice
steps.why_en: Decisions work for the furnish queue only; the UPL path has no receiver.
steps.why_id: Keputusan hanya jalan untuk antrian furnish; jalur UPL tidak punya penerima.

steps.en: The decision, remark, officer and date are saved
steps.id: Keputusan, remark, officer, dan tanggal disimpan
steps.why_en: Only the furnish queue saves a decision; the UPL save runs on staging only.
steps.why_id: Hanya antrian furnish yang menyimpan keputusan; simpan UPL hanya di staging.

steps.en: The notice resumes processing based on the decision
steps.why_en: Approval moves the notice on; rejection does nothing further.
steps.why_id: Persetujuan memajukan notice; penolakan tidak melakukan apa-apa lagi.
